content: Labeled Dataset Generation and Simulated User Creation. We create a simulated user for each KB to evaluate LiLi. We create the labeled datasets, the simulated user’s knowledge base ( INLINEFORM0 ), and the base KB ( INLINEFORM1 ) from INLINEFORM2 . INLINEFORM3 used as the initial KB graph ( INLINEFORM4 ) of LiLi.
